theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.regressionOffset_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem regressionOffset_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (B : Square n) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    regressionOffset P plan B j =
      ⟪measurementVector plan (P j), measurementVector plan B⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.regressionOffset_sub
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem regressionOffset_sub {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (A B : Square n) : regressionOffset P plan (A - B) =
      regressionOffset P plan A - regressionOffset P plan B

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.regressionOffset_represent
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem regressionOffset_represent {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    regressionOffset P plan (represent P c) = gram P plan *ᵥ c

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_residual_equation
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_residual_equation {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (A : Square n) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    gram P plan *ᵥ (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan) - c) =
      regressionOffset P plan (A - represent P c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_batch_residual_equation
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_batch_residual_equation {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n) (copy : Fin 15) (A : Square n)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    gram P (schedule copy) *ᵥ
      (singleOutput P (schedule copy)
        (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy) - c) =
      regressionOffset P (schedule copy) (A - represent P c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficientVector_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficientVector_inner {m : ℕ} (c d : Fin m → ℝ) :
    dot c d = ⟪coefficientVector c, coefficientVector d⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficientVector_norm_sq
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficientVector_norm_sq {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → ℝ) :
    dot c c = ‖coefficientVector c‖ ^ 2

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficient_error_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficient_error_bound {m : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hLower : ∀ d : Fin m → ℝ, α * dot d d ≤ dot d (G *ᵥ d))
    (d z : Fin m → ℝ) (heq : G *ᵥ d = z) :
    dot d d ≤ (1 / α ^ 2) * dot z z

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_coefficient_error
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_coefficient_error {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (A : Square n) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hLower : ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, α * dot d d ≤ dot d (gram P plan *ᵥ d)) :
    dot (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan) - c)
      (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan) - c) ≤
      (1 / α ^ 2) * dot (regressionOffset P plan (A - represent P c))
        (regressionOffset P plan (A - represent P c))

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_sub
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_sub {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (c d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    represent P (c - d) = represent P c - represent P d

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormal_frobenius_sq
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormal_frobenius_sq {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (c d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius
      (represent (orthonormalMember P) c) (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 =
      dot (d - c) (d - c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.exists_orthonormal_analysis_optimum
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem exists_orthonormal_analysis_optimum {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (A : Square n) :
    ∃ c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) c) = optimum P A ∧
      (∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
        NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c)
          (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) = 0) ∧
      ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
        NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
          (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 =
            optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleCopy_squared_error_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleCopy_squared_error_bound {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hPyth : ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 = optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c))
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
      (represent P (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan))) ^ 2 ≤
        optimum P A ^ 2 + (1 / α ^ 2) *
          dot (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))
            (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.exists_oneCopy_error_analysis
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem exists_oneCopy_error_analysis {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (A : Square n) :
    ∃ c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) c) = optimum P A ∧
      (∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
        NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c)
          (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) = 0) ∧
      (∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
        NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
          (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 = optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c)) ∧
      ∀ (plan : Plan n) (α : ℝ), 0 < α → OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α →
        NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
          (represent P (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan))) ^ 2 ≤
          optimum P A ^ 2 + (1 / α ^ 2) *
            dot (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))
              (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleCopy_relative_squared
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleCopy_relative_squared {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hPyth : ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 = optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c))
    (ξ : ℝ) (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan (1 / 2))
    (hOffset : dot
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c)) ≤
        (ξ / 4) * optimum P A ^ 2) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
      (represent P (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan))) ^ 2 ≤
        (1 + ξ) * optimum P A ^ 2

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleCopy_batch_relative_squared
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleCopy_batch_relative_squared {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (A : Square n) (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n) (copy : Fin 15) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hPyth : ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 = optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c))
    (ξ : ℝ) (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P (schedule copy) (1 / 2))
    (hOffset : dot
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) (schedule copy) (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) (schedule copy) (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c)) ≤
        (ξ / 4) * optimum P A ^ 2) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
      (represent P (singleOutput P (schedule copy)
        (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy))) ^ 2 ≤
        (1 + ξ) * optimum P A ^ 2

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleCopy_zero_optimum_exact
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleCopy_zero_optimum_exact {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hPyth : ∀ d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.frobenius A
        (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) ^ 2 = optimum P A ^ 2 + dot (d - c) (d - c))
    (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan (1 / 2))
    (hOpt : optimum P A = 0)
    (hOffset : dot
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c))
      (regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) plan (A - represent (orthonormalMember P) c)) ≤ 0) :
    A = represent P (singleOutput P plan (planAnswers A plan))
